messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: org=HelioApps sustained error-rate and token QPS spike detected. Autosafety applied: org rate-limit=120r/s -> temporary cap=60r/s. Notifying on-call.
alice (oncall): Ack. Paging in SRE + runtime. Priya, do we have customer impact? :rotating_light:
priya (support): HelioApps reporting timeouts in EU region, a lot of streaming responses failing mid-token. They've filed a ticket 10432. They're seeing request timeouts ~5-10s.
ben (sre): Looking at infra dashboards — origin qps jumped x4, token burst causing KV eviction pressure. 503s correlate with Redis saturation and per-connection queue growth.
lina (eng-runtime): Confirmed: runtime logs show stalled kv-cache lookups and high lock contention on shard-7. Streaming workers falling behind and causing router backpressure.
alice (oncall): Options: 1) further lower org cap to 30r/s 2) disable streaming for that org (fallback to non-streaming) 3) move traffic to another region. What is fastest to mitigate?
lina (eng-runtime): Fastest -> flip streaming->non-streaming flag for org. That avoids long-lived connections and reduces KV pressure. I'll push change if SRE ok.
ben (sre): I'm comfortable with that. Also recommend temporary per-org concurrency limit (conn limit 8) while we stabilize.
priya (support): Communicated to HelioApps that we're applying a temporary mitigation and will keep them updated.
jordan (customer-success): I'll join the call with them in 10m. Please call out expected degradation in streaming UX.
alice (oncall): Lina, can you show the command you'll run? Paste it here so we can audit.
lina (eng-runtime): Sure.
``` 
# admin-api call to set org feature flags and concurrency
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/orgs/helioapps/mitigate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"streaming_enabled": false, "conn_limit": 8, "temporary_note": "emergency: 2026-03-17 org surge"}'
```
ben (sre): I'll also pre-apply an emergency rate-floor at the router so requests above cap are soft-rejected with 429 and not queued. Command:
```
redis-cli -h router-leader ACL SETUSER helioapps-temp on >session
# pseudo: set org-rate-limit helioapps 30
adminctl set-rate helioapps 30 --expires=1h --reason="surge mitigation"
```
alice (oncall): Execute when ready. Lina, flip streaming off first, then Ben apply rate-floor. Priya to update ticket and slack thread.
lina (eng-runtime): Flipping streaming flag now... done. Observability: connections drop ~60%, avg latency for non-streaming requests down 40%.
priya (support): Noted. Updating ticket: "Applied streaming->non-streaming fallback at 11:07 UTC, monitoring." Adding HelioApps contact to thread.
ben (sre): Applying soft rate-floor to 30r/s now.
adminctl: success — helioapps rate set to 30r/s (expires in 1h)
alice (oncall): Monitoring metrics. Error-rate falling from 8% -> 1.2% in the last 3m. Good signal.
jordan (customer-success): HelioApps said they see much fewer timeouts. They've disabled a heavy client-side retry loop per our suggestion.
lina (eng-runtime): Still seeing some KV eviction churn; I'm tuning cache eviction thresholds and will patch a hotfix that reduces lock hold time. ETA ~2h.
ben (sre): I'll keep an eye on router queue length and be ready to divert traffic to secondary region if needed.
priya (support): Keeping HelioApps updated: next update in 15m or earlier if anything changes.
alice (oncall): Great. Plan: 1) keep org rate at 30r/s for 1h, 2) monitor for stability 30m, 3) if stable, increment to 45r/s then 60r/s, 4) document mitigation steps in incident ticket. Ben/Lina own infra/root cause work, Priya owns customer comms. ops-next-oncall you'll pick up timeline at 11:45 UTC.
ops-next-oncall: ack, will take follow-up at 11:45 UTC and start postmortem template.
priya (support): Ticket updated with mitigation steps and timeline.
alice (oncall): Closing this page for active mitigation — re-open if error rate >3% or token QPS >2x baseline. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: org=HelioApps mitigation applied by alice, ben, lina. Current status: degraded->stabilizing. Incident ID: INC-20260317-8342.
